crossRefs.note: Wait for Yahweh, and keep his way, and he will exalt you to inherit the land. When the wicked are cut off, you shall…
All mankind shall be afraid. They shall declare the work of God, and shall wisely ponder what he has done.
Zion heard and was glad. The daughters of Judah rejoiced because of your judgments, Yahweh.
The righteous see it, and are glad. The innocent ridicule them,
Your eyes will see, and you will say, “Yahweh is great—even beyond the border of Israel!”
Who wouldn’t fear you, Lord, and glorify your name? For you only are holy. For all the nations will come and worship…
I heard the angel of the waters saying, “You are righteous, who are and who were, O Holy One, because you have judged…
“Rejoice over her, O heaven, you saints, apostles, and prophets; for God has judged your judgment on her.”
After these things I heard something like a loud voice of a great multitude in heaven, saying, “Hallelujah! Salvation…
for his judgments are true and righteous. For he has judged the great prostitute, who corrupted the earth with her…
He has put a new song in my mouth, even praise to our God. Many shall see it, and fear, and shall trust in Yahweh.
My flesh trembles for fear of you. I am afraid of your judgments.
The righteous shall rejoice when he sees the vengeance. He shall wash his feet in the blood of the wicked,
so that men shall say, “Most certainly there is a reward for the righteous. Most certainly there is a God who judges…
this is the word which Yahweh has spoken concerning him. The virgin daughter of Zion has despised you and ridiculed…

translations.web: The righteous also will see it, and fear, and laugh at him, saying,
translations.bsb: The righteous will see and fear; they will mock the evildoer, saying,
translations.kjv: The righteous also shall see, and fear, and shall laugh
translations.asv: The righteous also shall see it, and fear, And shall laugh at him, saying,
